rows.note: Use 偽裝 as the all-purpose noun for a disguise or the act of concealing identity.

example.english: They took off their disguise and showed their true face.
example.traditional: 佢除低偽裝，露出真面目。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ceoi4 dai1 ngai6 zong1 lou6 ceot1 zan1 min6 muk6

rows.note: Use 裝扮 for the clothing, makeup, or overall get-up used as the physical disguise.

example.english: This disguise is really good; even I couldn't recognize you.
example.traditional: 呢套裝扮真係幾好，連我都認唔出你。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zong1 baan6 zan1 hai6 gei2 hou2 lin4 ngo5 dou1 jing6 m4 ceot1 nei5

rows.note: Use 扮 in casual speech when someone changes their appearance or acts as another person, especially by taking on a role or identity.

example.english: They disguise themselves as students to get into the venue.
example.jyutping: keoi5 baan6 hok6 saang1 wan6 jap6 wui6 coeng4

rows.note: Use 偽裝 as the all-purpose verb for deliberately disguising a person, thing, identity, or intention, especially in formal or explicit wording.

example.english: They disguise themselves as maintenance workers to sneak into the building.
example.traditional: 佢哋偽裝成工程人員，偷偷入咗大廈。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ngai6 zong1 sing4 gung1 cing4 jan4 jyun4 tau1 tau1 jap6 zo2 daai6 haa6

rows.note: Use 掩飾 when concealing true intentions, feelings, or another fact behind a misleading appearance.

example.english: They keep smiling to disguise their nervousness.
example.traditional: 佢一路笑，其實係掩飾緊自己嘅緊張。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 lou6 siu3 kei4 sat6 hai6 jim2 sik1 gan2 zi6 gei2 ge3 gan2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 假象 for a deceptive outward appearance that hides the reality underneath.

example.english: The apparent peace is just a disguise.
example.jyutping: biu2 min6 wo4 ping4 zi2 hai6 gaa2 zoeng6
